source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ Περὶ τῶν αὐτῶν ἔτι, καὶ περὶ τῶν ἐν ἁγίᾳ σκηνῇ Ἀρά σοι σαφὴς, ὦ Παλλάδιε, καὶ ἀποχρῶν ὁ λόγος, ὃν ἐπὶ τῇ ἁγίᾳ σκηνῇ καὶ τῶν ἐν αὐτῇ πεποιήμεθα;
pass_a_gloss: BOOK TEN. Peri tōn autōn eti / Concerning the same still, kai peri tōn en hagia skēnē / and concerning the things in holy tent. Ara soi saphēs / Is clear to you, ō Palladie…
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK TEN. Concerning the same things still, and concerning the things in the holy tent. Is the word clear to you then, O Palladius, and sufficient, which we have made upon the holy tent and the things in it?

anf_compare.notes: No PD complete English of Cyril De adoratione Book 10. Sense from PG 68 Greek lock. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew.
